invariants.rationale: Option always non-null regardless of value, as per standard Java Option usage.
A non-empty Option result only occurs if the metadata table exists and is enabled or available.
If this instance is itself a metadata table, then the Option returned is always empty.
No code path disables 'autoDetectAndDeleteMetadataPartitions' for present Option, thus if result is present, invariants about this flag hold.
Creation of a non-empty Option requires a non-null policy parameter.
